decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO26 to GPIO33 does not change the selected ESP32-S3 controller family.
The source changes only the SPI MOSI assignment; the boost-enable assignment remains GPIO5.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or load coverage.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not alter the standalone USB power source, activation condition, or powered rail.
The addressable LEDs use GPIO13 for data, and the source changes only SPI MOSI from GPIO26 to GPIO33.
The source does not change the sensor board's connector-fanout role or its interface scope.
The charge-status interface uses GPIO13 and its external LED circuitry is unaffected by the SPI MOSI reassignment.
The SPI MOSI GPIO change does not affect battery protection behavior or circuitry.
The SPI MOSI GPIO change does not affect the battery NTC connection or thermal-monitoring behavior.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not change the AXP2101 power path, battery input range, or load coverage.
Changing one GPIO assignment does not alter the number or functional separation of the project boards.
